description: Create a saved search alert so FlatHunt notifies the user about new matching Berlin listings. Accepts housing, price, size, rooms, availability, canonical area ids, amenity and rental-policy filters. Email notifications are enabled by default; Telegram too when the user has linked Telegram on FlatHunt. Requires the alerts.write scope.

amenityTags.description: Canonical amenity tags (AND). Backend filters listings that have ALL of these tags. Catalog (snake_case only): wifi, parking, bike_parking, wheelchair, dishwasher, washing_machine, dryer, elevator, balcony, desk, tv, oven, heating, furnished, fridge, microwave, cooktop, coffee_machine, iron, hair_dryer, closet, wardrobe, bed, bathtub, shower, garden, basement, air_conditioning, parking_street, workspace, fitness, concierge, laundry, pets_friendly. Do not invent aliases (wiFi, hasWifi, Waschmaschine).

anmeldungLikely.description: true = Anmeldung likely (broader). Prefer for "with Anmeldung" unless the user needs a hard guarantee.

areas.description: Canonical Berlin area IDs from list_areas (e.g. berlin:ortsteil:prenzlauer-berg). Up to 20 IDs; multiple IDs are combined with OR. District / Ortsteil mode — do not mix with lat/lng/radiusKm. When the user names an area, call list_areas first. Pass only canonical IDs returned by list_areas. Never construct, translate, normalize, or guess IDs.

availableFrom.description: Available from / not earlier than (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. "2026-08-01".

bedroomsMin.description: Minimum number of bedrooms (from provider extra data when available).

housingType.description: Type of housing. Studios map to apartment; room includes both private and shared rooms unless roomType narrows it.

lat.description: Latitude for nearby search; must be provided with lng (+ radiusKm). Do not mix with areas.

lng.description: Longitude for nearby search; must be provided with lat (+ radiusKm). Do not mix with areas.

name.description: Optional short label for the saved search (max 120 characters). If omitted, FlatHunt derives a concise label from housing type, budget and location filters.

noSchufaLikely.description: true = Schufa likely not required (broader). Prefer for "without Schufa".

personsMaxMin.description: Minimum capacity (personsMax). Use 2 for couples, 1 for solo — filters listings that can accommodate at least this many people.

providers.description: Restrict to specific housing providers (ids from the providers catalog).

radiusKm.description: Search radius in km around lat/lng (min 0.1, max 25). Nearby mode — do not mix with areas.

roomType.description: Room occupancy: private = one private bedroom in shared housing; shared = a bed in a shared bedroom. Omit to include both. housingType=room remains the broad backwards-compatible filter.

rooms.description: Exact room counts (OR). Allowed values only: "studio", "1", "2", …, "10" (strings, not numbers). Prefer over roomsMin/roomsMax for "1–2 rooms": ["1","2"] or ["studio","1"].

roomsMax.description: Maximum rooms. Prefer rooms[] for exact OR lists.

roomsMin.description: Minimum rooms (studio = 0). Prefer rooms[] for exact OR lists.

smokingAllowed.description: false = non-smokers only / smoking not allowed.

sortBy.description: Sort field (default rank). sortOrder is ignored when sortBy=rank. Cheaper first → price+asc; larger area → squareMeters+desc.

sortOrder.description: Sort direction (default desc). Ignored when sortBy=rank.

squareMetersMin.description: Minimum living area in m². "from 40 m²" → 40. Filter on the backend — do not paginate to drop small listings.

name: create_alert
title: Create a saved search alert
